text:
nora: Quick design check compact dashboard: legend above chart causes row misalignment when counts vary. sam: Seen that. On 3-up view some cards shift down and it looks messy. ivy: Can we convert legend to a small overlay pill 'Series (N)' that expands in-place without changing card height? lee: Overlay pill is good. When expanded it should be scrollable and not push layout. Add a subtle backdrop so it's visually layered. a11y-bot: Accessibility: pill must have aria-expanded, include series count in accessible name, and expand must move focus to first legend item. nora: Also units use condensed suffixes (K/M) at small sizes and expose full value on hover/focus. sam: Make the hover affordance keyboard accessible. Have a tiny caret that opens a popover with the raw number. ivy: For smoothing, separate "visual smoothing" (preserve spikes as markers) vs "resample" (reduce points for perf). Label them clearly in settings. lee: Outliers: prefer dim + marker rather than clipping axis. Show a tiny caret at axis edge when off-scale; tooltip explains "dimmed by auto-scale: value X (99.9th pct)". a11y-bot: Checklist addition: off-scale markers keyboard-focusable; announcement: "data point dimmed by auto-scale, value , percentile

"; popover controls must be reachable by keyboard. nora: Dev note: renderer prefers uniform alpha + mask texture for per-point dimming to avoid DOM churn. I'll sync with eng-runtime. sam: Action items: Ivy drafts pill microcopy + hidden aria examples; A11y-bot to add checklist items; Lee to prototype overlay behavior; Nora to file runtime note. ivy: I'll post copy options in #design later today. a11y-bot: Reminder: ensure focus return to trigger when overlay closes and focus outlines meet 4.5:1 contrast.
